evidence.observation: Ar flow dropped abruptly from ~100 to ~55 sccm at k=114 despite setpoint 100, recovering at k=126-128
Tube pressure fell in lockstep from ~3.05 to ~2.59 Torr during the same window, confirming a real flow loss rather than a sensor fault
Temperature held at setpoint ~750 °C throughout; heater power and O2 unremarkable
Cooldown proceeding normally: heater off, Ar 200 sccm, smooth ~0.4 °C/s decay

args.missing_evidence: Post-growth characterization (e.g., Raman/optical/AFM) of the film, plus MFC diagnostic/calibration check to confirm the ~60 s flow dropout at t≈3065-3125 s was a controller/MFC fault.
